releaseSummary: Staff can save a staged Stock Order Builder draft as a numbered quotation and continue with its populated DocStudio quotation document.
Price selection follows the account pricelist, Retail fallback, then published catalog price; a non-zero manual price requires a reason when no configured source can price the item.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Canonical stock quotations.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
